rules.name: rrr-price-bitexact-cfs-orm
rules.sql: SELECT coalesce(n.business_unit, o.business_unit) AS business_unit, coalesce(n.security_id, o.security_id) AS security_id, o.settle_price::text AS backup_price, n.settle_price::text AS current_price, n.updated_by, n.updated_timestamp FROM (SELECT * FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE business_unit IN ('CFS', 'ORM') AND value_date = :valueDate) n FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table WHERE business_unit IN ('CFS', 'ORM') AND value_date = :valueDate) o ON o.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND o.business_unit = n.business_unit AND o.security_id = n.security_id WHERE n.settle_price IS DISTINCT FROM o.settle_price OR n.settle_price::text IS DISTINCT FROM o.settle_price::text ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT coalesce(n.underlying_id, o.underlying_id) AS underlying_id, o.settle_value::text AS backup_settle_value, n.settle_value::text AS current_settle_value, o.risk_free_rate::text AS backup_risk_free_rate, n.risk_free_rate::text AS current_risk_free_rate, o.div_yield::text AS backup_div_yield, n.div_yield::text AS current_div_yield, n.updated_by, n.updated_timestamp FROM (SELECT * FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND value_date = :valueDate) n FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM opera_backup_04_10.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND value_date = :valueDate) o ON o.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND o.underlying_id = n.underlying_id AND o.value_date = n.value_date WHERE n.settle_value::text IS DISTINCT FROM o.settle_value::text OR n.risk_free_rate::text IS DISTINCT FROM o.risk_free_rate::text OR n.div_yield::text IS DISTINCT FROM o.div_yield::text ORDER BY 1
